title: New York State Senate Undergraduate Session Assistants Program
who_text: Full-time undergraduates at an accredited college or university in New York State with at least a 3.0 GPA
description: You work for the New York State Senate during its legislative session, from early January to late April. Session Assistants work at least 35 hours a week and are paid a stipend in installments every two weeks.

title: New York State Assembly Session Internship Program
who_text: Full-time college juniors and seniors in a degree program, in any major
description: You spend a legislative session working inside the New York State Assembly as a paid session intern. Students of all majors can apply, and applications for the 2027 session are available on the program page.

title: NYC Summer Youth Employment Program (SYEP)
sponsor: NYC Department of Youth and Community Development
who_text: New York City youth ages 14 to 24
description: SYEP gives New York City young people career exploration and paid work experience each summer. The 2026 application deadline was March 13, 2026.
